lines.text: Hello, have a seat. Tell me what's been happening.
I've been getting tingling in my left hand, mostly the thumb and first two fingers.
Um, my right hand, sorry, I'm getting tingling in the right, the left is fine.
Does it wake you at night?
Most nights the tingling wakes me, I shake it out and it goes.
Mind you, it's hard to tell when you're half asleep.
Typing all day for a boss who never says thank you doesn't help either.
Scribe, leave the bit about the boss out of the note.
Tapping over the wrist sets it off, and holding the wrists bent together for a minute brings it on too, so this looks like a nerve squeezed at the wrist.
Wear a wrist splint in bed every night for six weeks, keeping the wrist straight.
